environment.api: loopback through adb reverse with insecure demo account mode

flow.observed: The merchant screen displayed STAFF and VIEW_MERCHANT/CONFIRM_VISIT only after the server membership check.
Issued a one-person versioned claim slot for the configured demo customer.
The customer screen showed AVAILABLE, merchant ID, and expiry before any state change.
Redeem created one valid visit, one progress count, and the first fixed reward entitlement.
A repeated redeem returned HTTP 409; visit and entitlement counts remained 1:1.
The collection showed visit 1, app collectible 1, actual NFT 0, and NOT_REQUESTED as 발행하지 않음.
This PR keeps the manual one-time-code fallback; Android camera scanning is not claimed.

notes: Merchant mode is visibly labeled as a development screen rather than production authentication.
The collection hierarchy makes app collectible and actual NFT counts independently readable.
The floating gear is the Expo development-client overlay and is not part of a release build.
